args.text: THE removal count SHALL read the replaced section body as items: a line that begins with `- ` at column zero starts an item, a non-blank line at the start of the body or after a blank line starts an item, and every other non-blank line belongs to the item above it. Blank lines and every placeholder line the tool writes into an empty narrative section SHALL NOT be items, compared after trimming trailing whitespace: `-`, which the tool writes into an empty Rationale, and `- -`, which it writes into an empty Research / Analysis or Implementation Notes and which the block template of the bundled rules document carries.

WHEN a replace removes no item, because the section heading is absent, the body holds only the placeholder lines and blank lines of AC-1, or every old item reappears in the new text, THE SYSTEM SHALL write without the confirmation flag and report `removedItems: 0` and an empty `removedLines`.

The rules template docs/rule/SRS-MD-Rules-v2.6.0.md:2051 and :2055 carries `- -`.

Measured 2026-11-05 over docs/spec/*.srs.md, each heading body read to the next #### or ### line: Rationale holds only `-` 135 times, Research / Analysis only `- -` 605 times, Implementation Notes only `- -` 447 times, and no other one-line body of 12 characters or fewer occurs. A Rationale left as the template prose of the rules document is content to the count, not a placeholder.
